text: Cruio. Are we going to put this on this

kind. Incredible. This is incredible. A

An honor. Still can't believe Ominous
never told me about his arms. Ominous.
What will you do with Slytherin spell
book? What I do with every book? Read
it. Read it. Having professors as
parents ingrained that habit early on. I
can do that later. For now, I say we
explore this room. There's more to this
place. It's breathtaking.
I've been getting an uneasy feeling
about this place. We shouldn't linger
here. Let's find a way out, please. I
don't want to leave, but I owe you. both
of you. Without both of you, we'd never
have made it this far. Feels like
there's more stuff here.
Never do this again.
